operations.content: Every agent gets its own keys, tokens and credentials: never copy secrets between Hermes and Neocoder or into shared files, and never reuse one agent's login for the other.
Setup jobs must finish fully with a live test per component before calling done; user handles their own steps (keys, clicks, approvals) when asked and expects to be told exactly what is needed.
